justification: Standard — adds 2 new scanner layers to qa_gate.py (type boundaries + silent failures). No DB, no user-facing UI, but affects QA pipeline correctness for all future PRs.

pre_impl.existing_data: qa_gate.py already has DB guard scanner, null guard scanner, AST grounding, tier floor, commit hash binding. Adding type boundary + silent failure layers on top.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Scanners only run on diff files. If diff file list is empty or project_dir is None, returns empty list (no false failures).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New checks apply to all future pushes. Existing code is not retroactively gated — only changed files in each PR are scanned.

functions.name: scan_diff_for_type_boundaries
functions.input: list[str] diff file paths + str project_dir
functions.output: list[str] error messages appended to validate_report errors
functions.if_none: Returns empty list — no errors added

functions.name: scan_diff_for_silent_failures
functions.input: list[str] diff file paths + str project_dir
functions.output: list[str] error messages appended to validate_report errors
functions.if_none: Returns empty list — no errors added
